input_messages.content: Hi! I’d like to make some changes to my upcoming reservation, please.
Sure! My user ID is yara_garcia_1905 and the reservation ID is HXDUBJ.

I’d like to change my outgoing flight to a nonstop flight, departing one day later than originally scheduled. Also, I want to move my return flight from SFO back by one day as well. 

For both flights, I only want options that depart after 8am and before 9pm. Can you help me with that?
Yes, those options sound perfect! Please go ahead and change my reservation to those nonstop flights on the new dates. Let me know if there are any fees or anything else you need from me.

Yes, I confirm that I want to proceed with these changes. Also, just to clarify, since I have travel insurance, any change fees should be waived according to your website policy. Please make sure that’s honored. Let me know if you need anything else from me!

Thank you! Actually, I’d also like to upgrade my ticket to business class and add 2 checked bags for both flights. I’m willing to pay up to $200 for this. Can you check if that’s possible? If it’s more than $200, I’m okay with keeping economy for the return flight, but I still want business class for the outgoing flight and 2 checked bags.

If it’s not possible to upgrade within my budget, I’ll keep both flights in economy, but I definitely want to add 2 checked bags for each flight. Can you help me with that? I’m fine with paying for the bags using my original payment method.
Yes, that’s correct! Please go ahead and add 2 checked bags for each flight, and charge the $200 to my gift card. Thank you for your help!

That’s perfect, thank you so much for your help! I’m all set now. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
